ED Raids Former Punjab Minister Sundar Sham Arora's Residence

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) conducted a raid at the residence of former Punjab minister Sundar Sham Arora in Hoshiarpur early on Tuesday morning. The team reportedly arrived at Arora's home around 5 AM. Arora, a senior leader who served as the industries minister in the previous Congress government, is facing increased scrutiny. His lawyer stated that the reason for the raid was not provided.
